Application preparation checklist
HERE TO HELP

Good questions.
Clear answers.

Start with the essentials, then continue to the university’s official services.

Ask the admissions office ↗
Where do I apply?

Use the official university CMS to register or sign in and access Online Admissions. Check the current intake and eligibility before applying.

Visit the official portal ↗
Which name should I use on my application?

Enter your name and father’s name exactly as they appear on your Matriculation certificate or DMC.

Read the university’s instructions ↗
How do I check my provisional merit status?

Open the official merit search and enter your 13-digit CNIC without dashes.

Check provisional merit ↗
Where can I find hostel assistance?

The official hostel service asks for your CNIC and date of birth as recorded by the university. Follow its instructions or contact the hostel office for help.

Open the hostel service ↗
Does this website list every program?

The directory includes every undergraduate listing transcribed from the official Fall 2026 poster and selected postgraduate entries verified on a department page. It is not a complete current catalogue. Confirm eligibility and availability with the university.

Explore official academic information ↗
